The '''Claims Office''' was located in [[Tasariq City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. Managed by both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and the [[Tasari]] [[Council of Elders (Tasariq)|Council of Elders]], the Claims Office was responsible for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] claim registry and assaying.<ref name="J15" />
